blocks.zh: 「寫入URS的要求，即成為確效的驗收標準——URS不是願望清單，而是一份合約。」
blocks.en: "A requirement written into the URS becomes an acceptance criterion for qualification. The URS is not a wish list; it is a contract."

blocks.zh: Automation and Records / 自動化與記錄
blocks.en: Automation and Records

blocks.zh: 解說與確效連結 Commentary & Qualification Link
blocks.en: Commentary & Qualification Link

blocks.zh: 獨立監測系統的重要性 (6.1–6.3)
blocks.en: Why an Independent Monitoring System Matters (6.1-6.3)

blocks.zh: URS明確要求控制系統與監測系統必須獨立分開：控制系統負責驅動壓縮機維持溫度，監測系統負責記錄GMP數據並觸發警報。
blocks.en: The URS explicitly requires that the control system and the monitoring system be separate and independent: the control system drives the compressors to hold temperature, while the monitoring system records GMP data and triggers alarms.

blocks.zh: 兩個監測探頭分別放置在溫度映射（mapping）確定的最高溫區與最低溫區——這是mapping結果直接影響設備配置的體現。0.5°C準確度要求必須在OQ校驗中驗證。
blocks.en: The two monitoring probes are placed in the warmest zone and the coldest zone identified by temperature mapping. This shows how mapping results directly shape equipment configuration. The 0.5°C accuracy requirement must be verified through calibration during OQ.

blocks.zh: 考試重點：監測探頭位置由mapping決定，而非由供應商任意選擇。
blocks.en: Exam focus: monitoring probe locations are determined by mapping, not chosen arbitrarily by the supplier.

blocks.zh: BMS整合要求 (6.8) — GMP數據完整性核心
blocks.en: BMS Integration Requirement (6.8): the Core of GMP Data Integrity

blocks.zh: 要求6.8規定溫度數據必須歸檔至廠房BMS（建築管理系統）。這代表：
blocks.en: Requirement 6.8 states that temperature data must be archived to the site BMS (building management system). This means:

blocks.zh: 數據不能只存在設備本地記憶體，必須傳輸至受控BMS
blocks.en: Data cannot reside only in the equipment's local memory; it must be transferred to a controlled BMS

blocks.zh: BMS本身須符合21 CFR Part 11或等同要求（審計追蹤、電子簽名）
blocks.en: The BMS itself must meet 21 CFR Part 11 or equivalent requirements (audit trail, electronic signatures)

blocks.zh: IQ階段需確認BMS通訊連接；OQ需確認數據傳輸完整性
blocks.en: IQ must confirm the BMS communication link; OQ must confirm the integrity of data transfer

blocks.zh: PQ需確認在實際操作條件下BMS持續記錄不中斷
blocks.en: PQ must confirm that the BMS records continuously, without interruption, under actual operating conditions

blocks.zh: 比喻：警報延遲計時器（6.13）
blocks.en: Analogy: The Alarm Delay Timer (6.13)

blocks.zh: 想像每個警報有一個「冷靜期」——門開了5秒不會立即觸發警報，因為操作員可能正在快速進出。延遲計時器讓系統只在真實異常持續後才觸發，減少誤報（nuisance alarms）。
blocks.en: Picture a "grace period" on every alarm. A door open for 5 seconds should not trigger an alarm immediately, because an operator may simply be passing in and out quickly. The delay timer lets the system alarm only after a genuine excursion persists, which reduces nuisance alarms.

blocks.zh: 這個延遲設定值必須在OQ中記錄並測試：「將門打開X秒，確認警報在Y秒後觸發。」
blocks.en: This delay setting must be recorded and tested in OQ: "Open the door for X seconds and confirm that the alarm triggers after Y seconds."

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11範圍說明（6.6注釋）
blocks.en: Scope of 21 CFR Part 11 (Note to 6.6)

blocks.zh: URS明確排除冷藏控制系統（不提供記錄）不需符合21 CFR Part 11，但獨立監測系統（提供GMP記錄）必須符合。這是刻意的範圍界定，避免過度合規要求增加成本，同時保護品質關鍵數據。
blocks.en: The URS explicitly states that the cold room control system (which does not provide records) need not comply with 21 CFR Part 11, whereas the independent monitoring system (which provides GMP records) must. This is a deliberate scoping decision: it avoids over-compliance that adds cost while still protecting quality-critical data.

blocks.zh: CDMO在撰寫URS時需明確定義哪個子系統屬於Part 11範疇。
blocks.en: When writing a URS, the CDMO needs to define clearly which subsystem falls within the scope of Part 11.

blocks.zh: 冗餘設計（Lead-Lag模式）(6.10, 6.16)
blocks.en: Redundant Design (Lead-Lag Mode) (6.10, 6.16)

blocks.zh: Lead-Lag模式：兩台壓縮機組輪流作為主機（Lead）和備機（Lag），確保均勻使用壽命。當主機故障或溫度超標時，系統自動切換至備機——這是業務連續性要求，在IQ中確認配置，在OQ中模擬故障切換測試。
blocks.en: Lead-Lag mode: two compressor units alternate as the lead and the lag (standby) unit, which equalizes wear and service life. When the lead unit fails or the temperature goes out of range, the system switches automatically to the lag unit. This is a business continuity requirement: the configuration is confirmed in IQ, and failover is tested by simulating a fault in OQ.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: URS 6.1要求兩個監測探頭，一個測高溫區、一個測低溫區。請問這兩個探頭的位置由哪個活動決定？在確效的哪個階段確認探頭實際安裝位置正確？
blocks.en: URS 6.1 requires two monitoring probes, one in the warmest zone and one in the coldest zone. Which activity determines the positions of these two probes? In which qualification phase do you confirm that the probes are actually installed in the correct positions?

blocks.zh: URS 6.8要求BMS歸檔。如果BMS在夜間維護期間離線2小時，CTC仍在運行，請問您的CAPA計劃應包含哪些要素？
blocks.en: URS 6.8 requires BMS archiving. If the BMS goes offline for 2 hours during overnight maintenance while the CTC is still running, what elements should your CAPA plan include?

blocks.zh: 為什麼ISPE建議控制系統與監測系統必須獨立？若共用同一系統，在GMP審計中會面臨什麼挑戰？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend that the control system and the monitoring system be independent? If they share a single system, what challenges would you face in a GMP audit?

blocks.zh: Design & Construction: Material, Mechanical, Utilities / 設計與建造：材料、機械、公用設施
blocks.en: Design & Construction: Material, Mechanical, Utilities

blocks.zh: 解說與確效連結 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary
Hygienic Design for GMP (7.1, 7.2, 8.9)

blocks.zh: 材料相容性和防蟲設計是GMP設施設計的基礎。Section 7的要求在IQ階段驗證——安裝後目視檢查所有接縫是否密封、材料規格是否符合。
blocks.en: Material compatibility and pest-proof design are fundamental to GMP facility design. The Section 7 requirements are verified in IQ: after installation, visually inspect that all seams are sealed and that the materials meet specification.

blocks.zh: Spor-Klenz®是過氧化氫基消毒劑，對不銹鋼316L以外的材料（如普通碳鋼、部分塑料）有腐蝕性。URS明確列出消毒劑名稱，供應商才能選擇正確材料。
blocks.en: Spor-Klenz® is a hydrogen peroxide-based disinfectant that corrodes materials other than 316L stainless steel (for example, ordinary carbon steel and some plastics). The URS names the disinfectant explicitly so that the supplier can select the correct materials.

blocks.zh: 溫控準確度的雙重標準（8.1）
blocks.en: Dual Standards for Temperature Control Accuracy (8.1)

blocks.zh: URS 8.1規定控制感測器準確度0.25°C（量測不確定度）/ 0.5°C（準確度）。注意：
blocks.en: URS 8.1 specifies a control sensor accuracy of 0.25°C (measurement uncertainty) / 0.5°C (accuracy). Note:

blocks.zh: 控制感測器（8.1）：0.25°C — 驅動壓縮機，決定設備實際溫度控制能力
blocks.en: Control sensor (8.1): 0.25°C. It drives the compressors and determines how well the equipment can actually control temperature

blocks.zh: 監測感測器（6.3）：0.5°C — 記錄GMP數據，觸發警報
blocks.en: Monitoring sensor (6.3): 0.5°C. It records GMP data and triggers alarms

blocks.zh: 兩套系統準確度規格不同，體現不同功能的不同要求。OQ必須分別校驗兩套系統。
blocks.en: The two systems have different accuracy specifications because their functions differ. OQ must calibrate and verify the two systems separately.

blocks.zh: 比喻：門簾與warm air infiltration（8.8）
blocks.en: Analogy: Door Curtains and Warm Air Infiltration (8.8)

blocks.zh: 想像冷藏室的門是一道熱空氣入侵的缺口。每次開門，溫暖潮濕的外部空氣湧入，壓縮機需要額外功耗拉回溫度，且加速結霜。乙烯門簾（vinyl curtain）是最簡單有效的解決方案——它不需要電力，不會故障，卻能顯著減少熱負荷。
blocks.en: Think of the cold room door as a gap through which hot air can invade. Each time the door opens, warm, humid outside air rushes in; the compressors need extra power to pull the temperature back, and frost builds up faster. A vinyl curtain is the simplest effective solution: it needs no power, cannot fail, yet significantly reduces the heat load.

blocks.zh: PQ階段會在門頻繁開關的操作條件下測試溫度恢復時間，驗證8.8的設計效果。
blocks.en: In PQ, temperature recovery time is tested under operating conditions with frequent door openings, which verifies the design effect of 8.8.

blocks.zh: IQ驗證清單：設計與建造
blocks.en: IQ Verification Checklist: Design and Construction

blocks.zh: 確認不銹鋼等級符合7.1材質規格（材質證書COC）
blocks.en: Confirm that the stainless steel grade meets the 7.1 material specification (material certificate of conformance, COC)

blocks.zh: 目視確認所有接縫密封（7.2）
blocks.en: Visually confirm that all seams are sealed (7.2)

blocks.zh: 確認防撞墩（bollards）安裝位置（8.5）
blocks.en: Confirm the installation positions of the bollards (8.5)

blocks.zh: 確認門廉或等效裝置已安裝（8.8）
blocks.en: Confirm that the door curtain or an equivalent device is installed (8.8)

blocks.zh: 確認排水設計防止冷凝水滴落（8.7）
blocks.en: Confirm that the drainage design prevents condensate from dripping (8.7)

blocks.zh: 確認蒸發器RTD安裝位置（8.2，記錄序號）
blocks.en: Confirm the installation position of the evaporator RTD (8.2, record the serial number)

blocks.zh: 確認公用設施連接規格（9.1，冷凝水壓力和溫度）
blocks.en: Confirm the utility connection specifications (9.1, condensate pressure and temperature)

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: URS 8.7要求防止冷凝水滴落。請設計一個OQ測試方案，在不同負載條件下驗證此要求。您會測量什麼？接受標準是什麼？
blocks.en: URS 8.7 requires preventing condensate from dripping. Design an OQ test approach that verifies this requirement under different load conditions. What would you measure? What is the acceptance criterion?

blocks.zh: 供應商報價的材料是304不銹鋼而非316L。URS 7.1只說「耐腐蝕」——您如何決定供應商是否符合此要求？
blocks.en: The supplier's quotation specifies 304 stainless steel rather than 316L. URS 7.1 says only "corrosion resistant". How do you decide whether the supplier meets this requirement?

blocks.zh: 要求9.1說明公用設施規格。這個要求由誰提供（工廠設施工程師或供應商）？在URS中是「供應商要驗證其設備可在此條件下運行」還是「廠方保證提供此條件」？
blocks.en: Requirement 9.1 states the utility specifications. Who provides this requirement (the plant facilities engineer or the supplier)? In the URS, is it "the supplier must verify that its equipment can operate under these conditions" or "the site guarantees to provide these conditions"?

blocks.zh: Electrical & Environmental Health & Safety / 電氣與環境健康安全
blocks.en: Electrical & Environmental Health & Safety
Power Redundancy Strategy (10.4-10.5)

blocks.zh: 這兩條要求共同確保電力供應的冗餘性：
blocks.en: Together, these two requirements ensure redundancy of the power supply:

blocks.zh: 10.4：冷藏室連接備用發電機電源——停電時壓縮機繼續運作
blocks.en: 10.4: the cold room is connected to standby generator power, so the compressors keep running during a power outage

blocks.zh: 10.5：兩台壓縮機組分別接不同MCC（馬達控制中心）——一個MCC故障不影響另一台壓縮機
blocks.en: 10.5: the two compressor units are connected to different MCCs (motor control centers), so the failure of one MCC does not affect the other compressor

blocks.zh: IQ階段需確認兩台壓縮機的電源回路確實來自不同MCC，並記錄MCC編號。OQ需模擬單一MCC斷電，確認另一台壓縮機自動接管。
blocks.en: IQ must confirm that the power circuits of the two compressors really come from different MCCs and record the MCC numbers. OQ must simulate a power loss on a single MCC and confirm that the other compressor takes over automatically.

blocks.zh: EHS要求與GMP確效的邊界
blocks.en: The Boundary Between EHS Requirements and GMP Qualification

blocks.zh: Section 11的要求（噪音、緊急出口、冷媒監測）屬於EHS類型，但這不代表在藥廠確效中可以忽略：
blocks.en: The Section 11 requirements (noise, emergency exit, refrigerant monitoring) are EHS type requirements, but this does not mean they can be ignored in pharmaceutical qualification:

blocks.zh: 噪音（11.1）：IQ目視確認隔音設計；OQ實際量測dB值
blocks.en: Noise (11.1): IQ visually confirms the sound-insulation design; OQ measures the actual dB value

blocks.zh: 緊急出口（11.2）：IQ確認內部緊急把手安裝；功能測試在IQ完成
blocks.en: Emergency exit (11.2): IQ confirms that the internal emergency release handle is installed; the functional test is completed in IQ

blocks.zh: 緊急按鈕（11.3）：IQ確認安裝；OQ功能測試（按鈕→外部指示燈亮、BMS接收警報）
blocks.en: Emergency button (11.3): IQ confirms installation; OQ functional test (button pressed, external indicator light comes on, BMS receives the alarm)

blocks.zh: 冷媒洩漏監測（11.4）：IQ確認感測器安裝；OQ功能測試（模擬觸發→火警系統回應）
blocks.en: Refrigerant leak monitoring (11.4): IQ confirms sensor installation; OQ functional test (simulate a trigger and check the fire alarm system response)

blocks.zh: 比喻：電氣標準（10.1）
blocks.en: Analogy: Electrical Standards (10.1)

blocks.zh: NEC/UL/CE就像建築的法規許可——它們確保最低安全標準。在藥廠的GMP確效中，這些標準是「入場票」：如果設備不符合NEC/UL，IQ就直接失敗，因為連基本安全合規都未達到，遑論藥品品質合規。
blocks.en: NEC/UL/CE are like building code permits: they ensure minimum safety standards. In GMP qualification they are the "entry ticket". If the equipment does not comply with NEC/UL, IQ fails outright, because if even basic safety compliance is not met, pharmaceutical quality compliance is out of the question.

blocks.zh: 冷媒洩漏與GMP的關係（11.4）
blocks.en: Refrigerant Leaks and GMP (11.4)

blocks.zh: 現代冷藏室常使用HFC或低GWP冷媒。冷媒洩漏：
blocks.en: Modern cold rooms often use HFC or low-GWP refrigerants. A refrigerant leak:

blocks.zh: 危害人員安全（高濃度窒息或中毒）
blocks.en: Endangers personnel safety (asphyxiation or poisoning at high concentrations)

blocks.zh: 影響產品完整性（壓縮機停機→溫度偏差→OOS事件）
blocks.en: Affects product integrity (compressor shutdown, then temperature excursion, then an OOS event)

blocks.zh: 需要環境合規報告（冷媒排放法規）
blocks.en: Requires environmental compliance reporting (refrigerant emission regulations)

blocks.zh: 因此11.4雖標記EHS，實際上也直接連結GMP數據完整性和產品保護。
blocks.en: Therefore, although 11.4 is labeled EHS, it is in practice also directly linked to GMP data integrity and product protection.

blocks.zh: URS 10.5要求兩台壓縮機來自不同MCC。在IQ檢查表中，您如何記錄此要求已滿足？請寫出具體的檢查步驟和記錄格式。
blocks.en: URS 10.5 requires the two compressors to be supplied from different MCCs. How do you document in the IQ checklist that this requirement has been met? Write out the specific check steps and the record format.

blocks.zh: URS 11.1噪音要求85 dB(A)。如果OQ量測結果為87 dB(A)，您應如何處理？是偏差報告、設計變更還是要求豁免？
blocks.en: URS 11.1 sets a noise requirement of 85 dB(A). If the OQ measurement is 87 dB(A), how should you handle it? Deviation report, design change, or request a waiver?

blocks.zh: EHS要求（Type E）是否需要納入藥廠的確效主計劃（VMP）？說明您的立場和理由。
blocks.en: Do EHS requirements (Type E) need to be included in the site's validation master plan (VMP)? State your position and reasoning.

blocks.zh: Operations and Maintenance / 操作與維護
blocks.en: Operations and Maintenance

blocks.zh: URS中的SOP要求（13.2–13.3）
blocks.en: SOP Requirements in the URS (13.2-13.3)

blocks.zh: URS不只規範設備本身，也規範操作文件。要求13.2和13.3明確要求SOP必須涵蓋：
blocks.en: The URS regulates not only the equipment itself but also operating documentation. Requirements 13.2 and 13.3 explicitly require the SOP to cover:

blocks.zh: 允許的儲存位置（防止阻擋氣流，影響溫度均勻性）
blocks.en: Permitted storage locations (to avoid blocking airflow and affecting temperature uniformity)

blocks.zh: 最大儲存量（過載可能超出設備設計負荷）
blocks.en: Maximum storage quantity (overloading may exceed the equipment design load)

blocks.zh: 警報應對程序（溫度警報→評估→處理→記錄）
blocks.en: Alarm response procedure (temperature alarm, then assessment, handling and recording)

blocks.zh: 這些SOP是PQ階段的前提條件——PQ需要在SOP指引下操作，驗證系統在實際使用條件下的表現。
blocks.en: These SOPs are a prerequisite for the PQ phase: PQ must be run under SOP guidance to verify system performance under actual use conditions.

blocks.zh: 維護可及性（13.1）對確效的影響
blocks.en: Impact of Maintenance Access (13.1) on Qualification

blocks.zh: 要求13.1是IQ和維護計劃的基礎。在IQ中需確認：
blocks.en: Requirement 13.1 is the basis for IQ and the maintenance plan. In IQ, confirm:

blocks.zh: 所有維護需要的通道（1m最小間距）是否保留
blocks.en: Whether all access routes needed for maintenance (1 m minimum clearance) have been preserved

blocks.zh: 儀器校驗點是否可及（6.2已要求感測器設計便於校驗）
blocks.en: Whether instrument calibration points are accessible (6.2 already requires sensors to be designed for ease of calibration)

blocks.zh: 緊急維修時技術員是否可以在不移除產品的情況下接觸關鍵部件
blocks.en: Whether, in an emergency repair, technicians can reach critical components without removing product

blocks.zh: 若IQ後發現維護通道不足，會是Design Qualification（DQ）的失敗，需要工程變更單（ECN）。
blocks.en: If inadequate maintenance access is discovered after IQ, it is a Design Qualification (DQ) failure and requires an engineering change notice (ECN).

blocks.zh: 門墊圈（Gasket）的GMP意義（13.4）
blocks.en: GMP Significance of Door Gaskets (13.4)

blocks.zh: 門墊圈是冷藏室的薄弱環節——老化後密封性下降，warm air infiltration增加，溫度偏差風險上升。設計為易更換的墊圈意味著：
blocks.en: The door gasket is a weak point of a cold room: as it ages its sealing performance declines, warm air infiltration increases, and the risk of temperature excursions rises. A gasket designed for easy replacement means that:

blocks.zh: PM計劃可定期更換，無需停止操作
blocks.en: The PM plan can replace it on schedule without stopping operations

blocks.zh: 更換後需執行密封性測試（如煙霧測試或溫度穩定性確認）
blocks.en: A seal integrity test (such as a smoke test or a temperature stability check) must be performed after replacement

blocks.zh: 變更控制程序是否適用取決於替換零件是否為「相同規格」
blocks.en: Whether change control applies depends on whether the replacement part is of the "same specification"

blocks.zh: URS 13.2要求SOP定義最大儲存量。這個數字從哪裡來？（提示：與溫度mapping和PQ條件有關）
blocks.en: URS 13.2 requires the SOP to define the maximum storage quantity. Where does this number come from? (Hint: it relates to temperature mapping and PQ conditions.)

blocks.zh: 如果門墊圈更換後，您發現溫度波動輕微增加（仍在規格內），是否需要啟動變更控制？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: After a door gasket is replaced, you find that temperature fluctuation has increased slightly (still within specification). Do you need to initiate change control? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: 一個CDMO有8台相同型號的冷藏室，操作SOP是共用的還是各自獨立的？維護計劃呢？
blocks.en: A CDMO has 8 cold rooms of the same model. Are the operating SOPs shared or separate? What about the maintenance plans?

blocks.zh: URS-to-Qualification Traceability Matrix / URS至確效可追溯矩陣
blocks.en: URS-to-Qualification Traceability Matrix

blocks.zh: What Is a Traceability Matrix? / 什麼是可追溯矩陣？
blocks.en: What Is a Traceability Matrix?

blocks.zh: 可追溯矩陣解說 Traceability Commentary
blocks.en: Traceability Commentary

blocks.zh: 矩陣的三個核心原則
blocks.en: Three Core Principles of the Matrix

blocks.zh: 完整性（Coverage）：每條URS要求至少連結一個確效測試。若某條要求沒有對應測試，這是確效計劃的缺口，必須填補或記錄為「N/A（不適用）及原因」。
blocks.en: Coverage: every URS requirement is linked to at least one qualification test. If a requirement has no corresponding test, this is a gap in the qualification plan; it must be filled or recorded as "N/A (not applicable) with the reason".

blocks.zh: 雙向可追溯：能從URS找到測試（向前追溯），也能從測試找回URS要求（向後追溯）。
blocks.en: Bidirectional traceability: you can find the tests starting from the URS (forward traceability), and you can trace from a test back to the URS requirement (backward traceability).

blocks.zh: 不得重複計算：一個OQ測試可驗證多條URS，但每條URS必須至少有一個測試。
blocks.en: No double counting: one OQ test can verify several URS requirements, but every URS requirement must have at least one test.

blocks.zh: 常見稽核發現：矩陣缺口
blocks.en: Common Audit Findings: Matrix Gaps

blocks.zh: URS 5.6（全負載測試）僅在部分負載下進行PQ——發現：未測試最壞情況
blocks.en: URS 5.6 (full-load test): PQ was performed only under partial load. Finding: worst case not tested

blocks.zh: URS 6.16（自動切換）未在OQ中進行故障模擬測試——發現：功能未驗證
blocks.en: URS 6.16 (automatic changeover): no fault simulation test in OQ. Finding: function not verified

blocks.zh: BMS整合（6.8）在IQ確認連接，但PQ未確認長期連續記錄——發現：無持續性證據
blocks.en: BMS integration (6.8): connection confirmed in IQ, but PQ did not confirm long-term continuous recording. Finding: no evidence of sustained performance

blocks.zh: URS要求列入矩陣但測試引用錯誤文件編號——發現：追溯性中斷
blocks.en: URS requirement listed in the matrix, but the test references the wrong document number. Finding: traceability broken

blocks.zh: 比喻：矩陣如同考試答題對照表
blocks.en: Analogy: The Matrix as an Exam Answer Key

blocks.zh: 想像URS是考試題目，確效測試是答案。可追溯矩陣是「題目-答案對照表」。若有題目沒有對應答案，審查委員（稽核員）立刻發現——無論實際設備功能多好，文件上的缺口就是缺口。
blocks.en: Imagine the URS is the exam questions and the qualification tests are the answers. The traceability matrix is the "question-to-answer cross-reference". If a question has no corresponding answer, the examiner (auditor) spots it immediately: however well the equipment actually works, a gap in the documentation is a gap.

blocks.zh: CDMO操作員常說：「但我們的設備確實有做到！」——沒有矩陣連結的書面證據，這句話在GMP世界無效。
blocks.en: CDMO operators often say, "But our equipment really does that!" Without documented evidence linked through the matrix, that statement carries no weight in the GMP world.

blocks.zh: URS 6.11要求三種警報（風機故障、門開過久、製冷系統故障）。您需要三個獨立的OQ測試還是一個測試覆蓋全部？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: URS 6.11 requires three alarms (fan failure, door open too long, refrigeration system failure). Do you need three separate OQ tests or one test covering all of them? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: URS 5.6要求測試空、半滿、全滿三種狀態。若CDMO的PQ只測試了「典型操作負載」，這是否合規？如何處理？
blocks.en: URS 5.6 requires testing in three states: empty, half-full and full. If the CDMO's PQ tested only a "typical operating load", is that compliant? How would you handle it?

blocks.zh: 您的可追溯矩陣顯示URS 8.3（FM防火要求）只有IQ引用。稽核員問：「您如何確保防火系統在整個設備壽命期間持續有效？」您如何回答？
blocks.en: Your traceability matrix shows that URS 8.3 (FM fire protection requirement) is referenced only in IQ. The auditor asks, "How do you ensure the fire protection system remains effective throughout the life of the equipment?" How do you answer?

blocks.zh: BMS Integration Checklist / 建築管理系統整合清單
blocks.en: BMS Integration Checklist

blocks.zh: BMS整合深度解說 Commentary
blocks.en: BMS Integration Commentary

blocks.zh: BMS整合的GMP法規依據
blocks.en: Regulatory Basis for BMS Integration in GMP

blocks.zh: URS 6.8的「BMS歸檔」要求背後是多個法規的交匯：
blocks.en: The URS 6.8 requirement for "BMS archiving" sits at the intersection of several regulations:

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211.68：電腦化系統必須有準確的輸入和輸出，具備備份和復原能力
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211.68: computerized systems must have accurate input and output, with backup and recovery capability

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11：電子記錄需有審計追蹤、電子簽名（若替代紙本）
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11: electronic records need audit trails and electronic signatures (if they replace paper)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 11：電腦化系統驗證，包括數據完整性、存取控制、備份
blocks.en: EU Annex 11: computerized system validation, including data integrity, access control and backup

blocks.zh: ISPE GAMP 5：BMS通常歸類為Category 4（可配置軟體）或Category 5（客製軟體），需要完整驗證
blocks.en: ISPE GAMP 5: a BMS is usually classified as Category 4 (configured software) or Category 5 (custom software) and requires full validation

blocks.zh: CDMO特有挑戰：多客戶多產品的BMS管理
blocks.en: CDMO-Specific Challenge: BMS Management for Multiple Clients and Products

blocks.zh: CDMO環境中，同一台冷藏室可能儲存不同客戶的原料或成品，BMS數據管理面臨：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, the same cold room may store raw materials or finished products for different clients, so BMS data management faces:

blocks.zh: 數據隔離：客戶A的溫度記錄不能與客戶B的混在一起
blocks.en: Data segregation: Client A's temperature records must not be mixed with Client B's

blocks.zh: 多份報告：每批次需生成對應客戶的溫度報告（不同格式需求）
blocks.en: Multiple reports: each batch needs a temperature report for the corresponding client (with different format requirements)

blocks.zh: 警報通知路由：特定冷藏室的警報通知應發給該客戶的負責人還是CDMO？
blocks.en: Alarm notification routing: should alarm notifications for a given cold room go to that client's responsible person or to the CDMO?

blocks.zh: 存取控制：客戶稽核員可以存取多少BMS歷史數據？
blocks.en: Access control: how much historical BMS data may a client auditor access?

blocks.zh: 這些問題需在URS撰寫階段與客戶協議時預先確認，不能在確效後才發現設計不足。
blocks.en: These questions must be settled with clients during URS drafting; an inadequate design must not be discovered only after qualification.

blocks.zh: 數據格式與API整合
blocks.en: Data Formats and API Integration

blocks.zh: 現代BMS整合趨勢包括：
blocks.en: Current BMS integration trends include:

blocks.zh: CSV匯出：標準格式，可直接匯入GMP文件系統（MES/LIMS）
blocks.en: CSV export: a standard format that can be imported directly into GMP document systems (MES/LIMS)

blocks.zh: OPC-UA：工業物聯網標準協定，安全加密，適合跨系統整合
blocks.en: OPC-UA: an industrial IoT standard protocol, securely encrypted, suited to cross-system integration

blocks.zh: REST API：允許品質系統直接查詢實時溫度數據，自動觸發偏差調查
blocks.en: REST API: allows the quality system to query real-time temperature data directly and automatically trigger deviation investigations

blocks.zh: MQTT：輕量級即時數據傳輸，適合多設備監測
blocks.en: MQTT: lightweight real-time data transmission, suited to monitoring multiple devices

blocks.zh: URS應明確規定數據格式，避免供應商交付後整合困難。
blocks.en: The URS should specify the data format explicitly to avoid integration difficulties after the supplier delivers.

blocks.zh: 比喻：BMS是設備的「黑盒子」
blocks.en: Analogy: The BMS Is the Equipment's "Black Box"

blocks.zh: 飛機黑盒子記錄所有飛行數據，事故後可重建事件序列。BMS對CTC扮演相同角色——當產品出現OOS（超出規格）問題，稽查員首先問：「請提供事件前後72小時的溫度記錄」。若BMS記錄完整，調查有據可查；若BMS數據缺失，整批產品的放行決策就建立在不完整的基礎上。
blocks.en: An aircraft black box records all flight data so that the sequence of events can be reconstructed after an accident. The BMS plays the same role for a CTC. When a product has an OOS (out of specification) problem, the inspector's first question is, "Please provide the temperature record for the 72 hours before and after the event." If the BMS record is complete, the investigation has evidence to work from; if BMS data is missing, the release decision for the whole batch rests on an incomplete foundation.

blocks.zh: OQ測試中，您模擬BMS網路中斷30分鐘。CTC本地記錄器繼續記錄。網路恢復後，如何確認30分鐘的數據空缺已被正確記錄和處理？這屬於哪類GMP文件？
blocks.en: In an OQ test you simulate a 30-minute BMS network outage. The CTC local recorder keeps recording. After the network is restored, how do you confirm that the 30-minute data gap has been correctly recorded and handled? What type of GMP document does this belong to?

blocks.zh: 一個CDMO有3台冷藏室儲存不同客戶的API。客戶A要求每週一次溫度報告，客戶B要求每批次報告，客戶C要求實時API存取。請描述BMS配置需要考慮哪些因素。
blocks.en: A CDMO has 3 cold rooms storing APIs for different clients. Client A requires a weekly temperature report, Client B requires a report for every batch, and Client C requires real-time API access. Describe the factors to consider in the BMS configuration.

blocks.zh: FDA 483觀察：「BMS中的CTC溫度警報setpoint與URS規定的警報setpoint不一致。」請描述您的CAPA計劃和預防措施。
blocks.en: FDA 483 observation: "The CTC temperature alarm setpoint in the BMS is inconsistent with the alarm setpoint specified in the URS." Describe your CAPA plan and preventive measures.

blocks.zh: Supplier Documentation Deliverables / 供應商文件交付清單
blocks.en: Supplier Documentation Deliverables

blocks.zh: 供應商文件管理解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Supplier Documentation Management Commentary

blocks.zh: 供應商資格審查（Supplier Qualification）與URS
blocks.en: Supplier Qualification and the URS

blocks.zh: 在URS發出詢價前，藥廠應先對潛在供應商進行供應商資格審查（Supplier Qualification / Vendor Qualification）：
blocks.en: Before issuing the URS in a request for quotation, the pharmaceutical company should first perform supplier qualification (also called vendor qualification) on potential suppliers:

blocks.zh: 問卷評估：供應商的品質系統（ISO 9001？）、GMP經驗、客戶參考案例
blocks.en: Questionnaire assessment: the supplier's quality system (ISO 9001?), GMP experience, and customer references

blocks.zh: 廠訪（Audit）：訪視供應商工廠，確認製造能力和品質管理
blocks.en: Audit: visit the supplier's plant to confirm manufacturing capability and quality management

blocks.zh: 樣品評估：要求供應商提供同型號設備的FAT記錄或確效報告
blocks.en: Sample evaluation: ask the supplier for FAT records or qualification reports for the same equipment model

blocks.zh: 質量協議（Quality Agreement）：確認供應商對GMP要求的承諾
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: confirm the supplier's commitment to GMP requirements

blocks.zh: 通過資格審查的供應商才進入核准供應商清單（ASL），才能向其發出URS詢價。
blocks.en: Only suppliers that pass qualification enter the approved supplier list (ASL), and only then can the URS be sent to them for quotation.

blocks.zh: FAT vs SAT：功能重疊但場景不同
blocks.en: FAT vs SAT: Overlapping Functions, Different Settings

blocks.zh: FAT通過可降低SAT和IQ的風險——早期發現問題，供應商有責任在出廠前修正。
blocks.en: A successful FAT reduces the risk at SAT and IQ: problems are found early, and the supplier is responsible for correcting them before shipment.

blocks.zh: As-Built Drawings 的GMP重要性
blocks.en: GMP Importance of As-Built Drawings

blocks.zh: As-built drawings（完工圖）記錄設備實際安裝後的真實狀態，與設計圖（design drawings）不同——設計圖是「計劃建造的」，as-built是「實際建造的」。
blocks.en: As-built drawings record the true state of the equipment after actual installation. They differ from design drawings: design drawings show what was "planned to be built", while as-built drawings show what was "actually built".

blocks.zh: 在IQ中必須確認as-built drawings已更新：若安裝過程有任何設計變更（如管路走向、電氣接點位置），必須反映在as-built drawing上，否則這份圖就是不準確的GMP記錄。
blocks.en: In IQ you must confirm that the as-built drawings have been updated: if any design change occurred during installation (such as pipe routing or the location of electrical connections), it must be reflected in the as-built drawing, otherwise the drawing is an inaccurate GMP record.

blocks.zh: 後續維護、變更控制、再確效都依賴as-built drawings作為基準文件。
blocks.en: Subsequent maintenance, change control and requalification all rely on the as-built drawings as the baseline document.

blocks.zh: 比喻：供應商文件是設備的「出生證明」
blocks.en: Analogy: Supplier Documents Are the Equipment's "Birth Certificate"

blocks.zh: 設備的每份文件——校驗證書、材質證明、as-built drawings——共同構成設備的完整「身份」。就像人的出生證明、學歷、醫療記錄，缺少任何一份，在某個重要時刻就會造成問題：
blocks.en: Every document for the equipment (calibration certificates, material certificates, as-built drawings) together makes up its complete "identity". Like a person's birth certificate, education record and medical history, the lack of any one of them will cause a problem at some important moment:

blocks.zh: 沒有校驗證書 → IQ無法關閉
blocks.en: No calibration certificate: IQ cannot be closed

blocks.zh: 沒有材質COC → 供應商審計不合格
blocks.en: No material COC: the supplier audit fails

blocks.zh: 沒有as-built → 維護後變更控制無基準
blocks.en: No as-built drawings: no baseline for change control after maintenance

blocks.zh: 沒有O&M手冊 → 操作員無GMP培訓依據
blocks.en: No O&M manual: operators have no basis for GMP training

blocks.zh: 供應商在FAT中發現一個警報延遲計時器的設定與URS不符。供應商在FAT前修正並在FAT報告中記錄。這個偏差是否需要在IQ中再次確認？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: During FAT, the supplier finds that the setting of an alarm delay timer does not match the URS. The supplier corrects it before FAT and records this in the FAT report. Does this deviation need to be confirmed again in IQ? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: As-built drawings顯示某感測器位置與P&ID不同（安裝時工程師現場判斷移位）。IQ應如何處理？是接受偏差、要求移回原位，還是更新P&ID？
blocks.en: The as-built drawings show that a sensor position differs from the P&ID (the engineer moved it on site during installation based on field judgment). How should IQ handle this? Accept the deviation, require the sensor to be moved back, or update the P&ID?

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的O&M手冊是英文版，但CDMO操作員主要使用中文。這在GMP文件要求下如何處理？
blocks.en: The O&M manual provided by the supplier is in English, but the CDMO operators mainly use Chinese. How is this handled under GMP documentation requirements?

blocks.zh: CDMO Fleet Management Considerations / CDMO多設備管理挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Fleet Management Considerations

blocks.zh: CDMO場景深度解說 Commentary
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario Commentary

blocks.zh: 單套URS vs 多設備現實
blocks.en: A Single URS vs the Reality of Multiple Units

blocks.zh: Appendix 1的示範URS是針對單一冷藏室（one cold room）的。在CDMO實踐中，您可能同時管理：
blocks.en: The example URS in Appendix 1 is for a single cold room. In CDMO practice, you may be managing at the same time:

blocks.zh: 3台廠商A的walk-in cold room（相同型號）
blocks.en: 3 walk-in cold rooms from Supplier A (same model)

blocks.zh: 2台廠商B的walk-in cold room（不同型號）
blocks.en: 2 walk-in cold rooms from Supplier B (different models)

blocks.zh: 4台不同廠商的–20°C冰箱
blocks.en: 4 –20°C freezers from different suppliers

blocks.zh: 2台–80°C超低溫冷凍箱
blocks.en: 2 –80°C ultra-low temperature freezers

blocks.zh: 最佳做法：為每個「設備族群」（相同廠商、相同型號）制定一份通用URS，個別設備的特定數據以「Appendix」形式附加。
blocks.en: Best practice: prepare one generic URS for each "equipment family" (same supplier, same model), and attach the data specific to individual units as an "Appendix".

blocks.zh: CDMO的確效主計劃（VMP）設計
blocks.en: VMP Design for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 針對CTC艦隊的VMP應包含：
blocks.en: A VMP for a CTC fleet should include:

blocks.zh: 所有CTC的清單（型號、位置、溫度範圍、用途）
blocks.en: A list of all CTCs (model, location, temperature range, use)

blocks.zh: 共用的IQ/OQ/PQ驗收標準模板
blocks.en: Shared IQ/OQ/PQ acceptance criteria templates

blocks.zh: 周期性再確效計劃表（每台的下次日期）
blocks.en: A periodic requalification schedule (next due date for each unit)

blocks.zh: 季節性再mapping政策（夏冬各一次？還是每年一次？）
blocks.en: A seasonal re-mapping policy (once in summer and once in winter, or once a year?)

blocks.zh: 溫度異常事件後的再確效SOP
blocks.en: An SOP for requalification after a temperature excursion event

blocks.zh: Matrix方法的科學依據（若採用）
blocks.en: The scientific rationale for the matrix approach (if adopted)

blocks.zh: 比喻：艦隊管理如同連鎖飯店的品質標準
blocks.en: Analogy: Fleet Management Is Like Quality Standards in a Hotel Chain

blocks.zh: 同一連鎖品牌的所有飯店共用服務標準（SOP）、裝修規格（URS），但每間飯店有自己的房間號碼（設備序號）和地址（安裝位置）。顧客（客戶/稽核員）在任何一間分店都能預期相同的服務品質。
blocks.en: All hotels in the same chain share service standards (SOPs) and fit-out specifications (URS), but each hotel has its own room numbers (equipment serial numbers) and address (installation location). Customers (clients/auditors) can expect the same quality of service at any branch.

blocks.zh: CDMO的CTC艦隊管理同理：標準化不是降低要求，而是讓合規管理更高效、更一致。
blocks.en: Managing a CDMO's CTC fleet works the same way: standardization does not lower requirements; it makes compliance management more efficient and more consistent.

blocks.zh: 您的CDMO計劃新增第4台相同型號的walk-in cold room。現有3台已完成完整IQ/OQ/PQ。您提議採用「矩陣方法」，只對新設備做IQ，OQ和PQ引用第1台的數據。法規上的依據是什麼？風險是什麼？您會如何向QA主管說明？
blocks.en: Your CDMO plans to add a 4th walk-in cold room of the same model. The existing 3 have completed full IQ/OQ/PQ. You propose a "matrix approach": perform IQ only on the new unit, with OQ and PQ referencing the data from unit 1. What is the regulatory basis? What are the risks? How would you explain it to the QA head?

blocks.zh: 您管理的CTC艦隊中，一台–20°C冰箱的BMS警報setpoint在系統維護中被意外更改（從–15°C改為–10°C）。這是變更控制事件嗎？需要重新確效嗎？BMS審計追蹤能幫助您嗎？
blocks.en: In the CTC fleet you manage, the BMS alarm setpoint of a –20°C freezer was accidentally changed during system maintenance (from –15°C to –10°C). Is this a change control event? Is requalification needed? Can the BMS audit trail help you?

blocks.zh: 客戶稽核要求提供「過去2年所有冷藏室的溫度記錄與確效狀態清單」。請描述您在CDMO中如何在30分鐘內準備這份清單（假設您有完善的VMP和BMS）。
blocks.en: A client audit requests "a list of temperature records and qualification status for all cold rooms over the past 2 years". Describe how, at a CDMO, you would prepare this list within 30 minutes (assuming you have a well-maintained VMP and BMS).

blocks.zh: Comprehensive Practice Questions & Section Review / 綜合練習與本節回顧
blocks.en: Comprehensive Practice Questions & Section Review

blocks.zh: 綜合練習題 Comprehensive Questions
blocks.en: Comprehensive Questions

blocks.zh: 您的CDMO正在安裝一台新的walk-in cold room（2–8°C），用於儲存多個客戶的API原料。供應商已提交報價，包含設備本身但未提及BMS整合或確效文件。
blocks.en: Your CDMO is installing a new walk-in cold room (2-8°C) to store API raw materials for multiple clients. The supplier has submitted a quotation that covers the equipment itself but does not mention BMS integration or qualification documents.

blocks.zh: 根據本節學習，列出您應要求供應商額外提供的5項最關鍵文件或服務。說明每項的GMP依據。
blocks.en: Based on what you learned in this section, list the 5 most critical additional documents or services you should require from the supplier. Explain the GMP basis for each.

blocks.zh: 您如何在採購合同中確保這些要求具有法律約束力（提示：引用URS）？
blocks.en: How do you make sure in the purchase contract that these requirements are legally binding (hint: reference the URS)?

blocks.zh: 採購完成後，設備在6個月後安裝。如何確保URS的要求在這6個月中沒有「被遺忘」？
blocks.en: After purchase, the equipment will be installed 6 months later. How do you make sure the URS requirements are not "forgotten" during these 6 months?

blocks.zh: FDA稽查員即將到來，宣告將重點稽查您的CTC管理系統。您有3週準備時間。
blocks.en: An FDA inspector is about to arrive and has announced that the inspection will focus on your CTC management system. You have 3 weeks to prepare.

blocks.zh: 列出您應提前準備的5類GMP文件（按優先順序），並說明稽查員最可能問的問題。
blocks.en: List the 5 categories of GMP documents you should prepare in advance (in priority order), and explain the questions the inspector is most likely to ask.

blocks.zh: 稽查員問：「請向我展示URS要求6.1（兩個獨立監測感測器）如何在您的OQ中被驗證。」請描述您的回答流程：從哪份文件開始，如何呈現證據。
blocks.en: The inspector asks, "Show me how URS requirement 6.1 (two independent monitoring sensors) was verified in your OQ." Describe your response: which document do you start with, and how do you present the evidence?

blocks.zh: 稽查員問：「過去一年，這台冷藏室有幾次溫度警報？每次的處理時間和根本原因是什麼？」如果您的BMS記錄完整，需要哪些文件來支持您的回答？
blocks.en: The inspector asks, "Over the past year, how many temperature alarms did this cold room have? What were the handling time and root cause for each?" If your BMS records are complete, which documents do you need to support your answer?

blocks.zh: 您的walk-in cold room的壓縮機（duty compressor）發生故障，供應商建議更換為更新型號（不同廠商，但同規格）。更換需要2天，期間使用備用壓縮機（standby）維持運作。
blocks.en: The duty compressor of your walk-in cold room fails, and the supplier suggests replacing it with a newer model (from a different manufacturer but with the same specification). The replacement takes 2 days, during which the standby compressor maintains operation.

blocks.zh: 這個更換是否需要啟動變更控制程序？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: Does this replacement require initiating the change control procedure? What is your reasoning?

blocks.zh: 更換後，哪些確效活動需要重新執行（IQ/OQ/PQ部分重做？全部重做？）？依據是什麼？
blocks.en: After the replacement, which qualification activities need to be repeated (partial IQ/OQ/PQ repeat? Full repeat?). What is the basis?

blocks.zh: 更換期間（2天），使用備用壓縮機維持2–8°C。這個「應急操作」需要哪些GMP文件來保護儲存中的產品？
blocks.en: During the replacement (2 days), the standby compressor maintains 2-8°C. What GMP documents are needed for this "emergency operation" to protect the stored product?

blocks.zh: 更換後的as-built drawings如何更新？誰負責更新和批准？
blocks.en: How are the as-built drawings updated after the replacement? Who is responsible for updating and approving them?

blocks.zh: 本節核心學習總結
blocks.en: Key Learning Summary of This Section

blocks.zh: URS是確效的起點和終點——所有確效測試的接受標準來自URS，所有結果回溯至URS
blocks.en: The URS is both the starting point and the end point of qualification: the acceptance criteria for all qualification tests come from the URS, and all results trace back to the URS

blocks.zh: 「Quality」類型要求是FDA/EMA稽查的主要焦點，必須有完整的OQ/PQ書面證據
blocks.en: "Quality" type requirements are the main focus of FDA/EMA inspections and must have complete documented OQ/PQ evidence

blocks.zh: BMS整合不只是IT任務，而是GMP數據完整性的核心——涉及21 CFR Part 11和數據可及性
blocks.en: BMS integration is not just an IT task but the core of GMP data integrity, involving 21 CFR Part 11 and data accessibility

blocks.zh: 可追溯矩陣是確效計劃完整性的客觀證明——每條URS要求必須有對應測試
blocks.en: The traceability matrix is objective proof of the completeness of the qualification plan: every URS requirement must have a corresponding test

blocks.zh: CDMO艦隊管理的關鍵：標準化文件框架+設備特定數據，平衡效率與合規
blocks.en: The key to CDMO fleet management: a standardized documentation framework plus equipment-specific data, balancing efficiency and compliance

blocks.zh: 供應商文件要求必須寫入URS並成為IQ關閉條件，不能在驗收後才追討
blocks.en: Supplier documentation requirements must be written into the URS and made a condition for IQ closure; they cannot be chased after acceptance
